review_candidates.description: Department: Sales Location: Canada-Ontario-Field based Compensation: CA$117,000 / year Description Both Orthodontists and Dentists are an integral part of our doctor driven business. Our goal is to deliver superior clinical outcomes with an enhanced patient experience. Our continued growth and success depends on enabling dental clinics to thrive. Your mission as a sales Territory Manager is to apply comprehensive knowledge of Invisalign and iTero sales strategies for key accounts to accelerate revenue and higher case volume. You will sell directly to professional business owners (Dentists and Orthodontists), transforming an analog process with clear aligners and innovative digital solutions that make straightening teeth easier, faster, and more accessible – helping practitioners grow their business and increase patient satisfaction. Role expectations Use insights and a consultative selling approach to teach customers about their industry and their customers; challenge them to modernize and grow their business; assist them in implementing digital technology and refine office processes. Achieve quarterly and yearly territory sales targets. Manage a defined geography of accounts to grow the business; onboard new high potential accounts. Plan and execute a Territory plan, based on understanding the potential in each account in the defined geography. Create & execute account plans for highest potential accounts, based on deep understanding of the account’s business, goals, challenges and opportunities. Utilize data/analytics to help customer’s drive decision making. Educate customers on products to ensure the practice is clinically comfortable with Invisalign and iTero products and services. Communicate cross-functionally (e.g., Doctor, Treatment Coordinator, clinical assistant, education, marketing, product development) to develop an in-depth understanding of the business needs to clearly articulate fit with Align product, digital platform, and solution capabilities. Orchestrate additional internal Company resources to optimize the customer experience and provide ongoing promotion of Align solutions. Be creative, self-disciplined and capable of identifying and completing critical tasks independently with a high sense of urgency. Be agile and capable of engaging customers in a virtual selling environment. Listen, understand, and analyze customer needs to tailor Align products and services to deliver a best-in-class customer experience. What We're Looking For Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent experience required. Minimum of 4 years of experience required. Experience can be outside business-to-business (B2B) sales experience or industry experience selling a medical device, capital equipment, dental or other relevant combination of sales (inside or outside) and industry experience. Proven track record of achieving sales goals. Possess and maintain a valid driver’s license. Business & Marketing knowledge: Ability & comfort having business discussions (Cash Flow Analysis, ROI, P&L) and asking the right business questions. Comfort with having clinical discussions regarding both Invisalign and iTero products. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. Experience with a CRM system, Salesforce preferred, and virtual communication platforms. Regular travel within assigned geographical territory required with the possibility of some overnight travel required. Some travel to the US will be required. Legally entitled to work in Canada and travel to the US on occasion. For roles in the province of Quebec, candidates must be French / English bilingual. For Field Sales roles, the salary listed is the base pay only and does not include the applicable incentive compensation plan. A cost of living adjustment may be added to base pay for higher cost areas in the U.S. Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay determined based on the position and your location, year in school, degree, and experience. We need someone who is comfortable picking up the phone every day, speaking to new prospects, handling rejection, following up, and continuously creating opportunities. What You’ll Do Make consistent outbound cold calls to mosques and prospective customers. Identify decision-makers such as mosque administrators, trustees, committee members and management teams. Qualify prospects and move genuine opportunities into the sales pipeline. Conduct follow-ups through phone, WhatsApp and email. Maintain accurate prospect and follow-up information in the CRM. Schedule product demonstrations and sales conversations. Work closely with the team to convert qualified opportunities into customers. Continuously build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline. What We’re Looking For The #1 requirement: You must be comfortable with cold calling. We want someone who: Can pick up the phone and start calling without hesitation. Is comfortable making repeated calls throughout the working day. Doesn't get discouraged by rejection or unanswered calls. Has strong verbal communication and persuasion skills. Can confidently speak with senior mosque/community decision-makers. Is proactive about finding and creating opportunities rather than waiting for leads. Can follow up consistently without being reminded. Understands basic sales principles and pipeline management. Is comfortable using WhatsApp, email and basic business tools/software. Has a sales mindset, persistence and hunger to build a pipeline. Language Requirements Urdu (Speaking) English (Speaking) Arabic (Reading) Experience in any of the following will be an advantage: B2B SaaS sales IT/software sales Tele-sales / inside sales Digital products or services Community/organization-focused sales Selling subscriptions or recurring-revenue products Experience dealing with religious institutions, NGOs, associations or community organizations Important Your primary responsibility is sales prospecting, cold calling, follow-ups and pipeline generation. If you enjoy speaking to new people, making calls, handling objections and turning conversations into opportunities, this role is for you. Performance-based growth opportunities available as the sales function expands. MSA Software LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Training will be provided; however, we expect you to learn quickly and apply this knowledge effectively in your day-to-day responsibilities while maintaining a professional and respectful approach to representing the platform and its mission. IMPORTANT: DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT COMFORTABLE LEARNING, ADAPTING TO, AND WORKING WITH STRONG CULTURAL AWARENESS, RELIGIOUS SENSITIVITIES, AND COMMUNITY-FOCUSED ENVIRONMENTS.

Learn the industry inside and out. Understand the incentives, pressure points, and decision-makers of your industry so you can build powerful, profitable relationships. Be a credible voice for the product. Speak about it with clarity and confidence. Gather feedback from clients and share insights to help shape future development. Follow the data. review_candidates.description: GO ROCK IT , c’est l’incontournable Agence de talents spécialisée dans les secteurs des technologies de l’information (TI) et du marketing numérique. Notre Agence se démarque pour la diversité et la richesse de l’expertise de ses talents, et pour le savoir-faire de son équipe de recrutement et de gestion de talents. Nous sommes au service de nos talents, pour répondre aux besoins de clients. En recherche d’amélioration continue, nous sommes déterminés à garantir des pratiques de recrutement justes et équitables pour tous. Notre processus de recrutement est entièrement transparent. Si le rôle qu’on te propose aujourd’hui n'est pas le bon pour toi, trouvons-en un qui le soit! Travaillons ensemble pour s’assurer que tu atteignes tes objectifs professionnels 💪 👇 À propos du poste : Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) Scientifique senior en IA appliquée pour rejoindre l'équipe de l'un de nos partenaires stratégiques à Montréal. 🛠️ Ce que tu feras : Contribuer à la réalisation de projets de transfert technologique, de recherche appliquée et de développement expérimental en intelligence artificielle. Concevoir, évaluer et adapter des solutions fondées sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), l’IA générative et l’apprentissage automatique, afin de répondre à des problématiques industrielles concrètes. Développer des preuves de concept et des prototypes, agir comme référence scientifique dans les projets et contribuer à l’encadrement technique des membres plus juniors de l’équipe. Accompagner les partenaires et les équipes dans l’évaluation, l’adoption et l’utilisation de nouvelles technologies en intelligence artificielle. Évaluer la faisabilité de différentes approches et formuler des recommandations adaptées au contexte du projet. Vulgariser des concepts complexes auprès d’auditoires techniques et non techniques, afin de favoriser la compréhension et l’appropriation des solutions proposées. Identifier des opportunités de recherche alignées sur les besoins des partenaires et les orientations stratégiques de l’organisation. Proposer et mener des projets de recherche appliquée permettant de faire progresser les connaissances, les méthodes et les pratiques en intelligence artificielle. 🧠 Qualifications recherchées : Doctorat en informatique, IA, ou discipline connexe. 7 à 10 ans d’expérience pertinente en intelligence artificielle, incluant une expérience significative en TALN, avec les grands modèles de langues. Expérience démontrée dans la conception et la réalisation de travaux de recherche, académiques ou industriels, ainsi que dans le passage de résultats scientifiques vers des preuves de concept, des prototypes ou des solutions transférées. Excellente maîtrise des méthodes d’apprentissage profond, de l’évaluation expérimentale et des environnements de développement en Python, ainsi que des principaux cadres logiciels utilisés pour les modèles de langage. Capacité à comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs/experts de domaine, d’en extraire des requis techniques et d’élaborer un plan de travail. Aise à vulgariser et communiquer à des auditoires experts et non experts. Maîtrise de la langue française et de l’anglais des affaires (clients francophones et anglophones). Postule directement ici! 💪 Même si tu es simplement curieux(se), fais-nous signe. Chez GO ROCK IT , nous valorisons l'équité, la diversité et l'inclusion. Nous sommes impatients de discuter avec toi et de découvrir comment nous pouvons t'aider à progresser dans ta carrière, dans un environnement dynamique et axé sur l’innovation où tu te sentiras respecté et valorisé.

review_candidates.title: Sales Manager
review_candidates.company: Crowne Plaza Phnom Penh by IHG (VM Hotel Phnom Penh)
review_candidates.description: Company Description Crowne Plaza Phnom Penh by IHG is a contemporary business-class hotel set within the CG Fortune Center, a mixed-use development near Phnom Penh International Airport, the hotel offers 136 well-appointed rooms designed for business and leisure travelers seeking comfort and convenience. Guests benefit from direct access to a premium shopping and lifestyle mall, commercial offices, and residential apartments within the same complex. The location provides a range of dining and entertainment options, making the hotel an attractive base for travelers and corporate guests in Phnom Penh. Role Description The Sales Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. This role is responsible for driving room and event revenue by developing and managing corporate, group, and leisure accounts, and cultivating strong relationships with travel agents, corporate clients, and other key partners. Day-to-day activities include identifying new business opportunities, preparing sales proposals and contracts, conducting site inspections, and negotiating rates and packages in line with IHG and hotel standards. The Sales Manager will monitor market trends and competitor activity, prepare regular sales reports and forecasts, and collaborate with Revenue, Marketing, and Operations teams to optimize hotel performance. The role also involves representing the hotel at trade shows, networking events, and client meetings to enhance brand visibility and support long-term business growth. Qualifications Proven experience in hotel or hospitality sales, with a strong track record in managing corporate, group, or MICE accounts. Solid skills in client relationship management, negotiation, and business development, with the ability to close deals and achieve sales targets. Experience in sales planning, forecasting, and reporting, including the use of sales and CRM systems. Strong communication and presentation skills in English; proficiency in Khmer or other languages is an advantage. Understanding of hospitality revenue management, pricing strategies, and market segmentation. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and maintain a professional, service-focused approach. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Availability to work on-site in Phnom Penh and to attend client visits, events, and industry functions as required.

review_candidates.title: Sales Attendant
review_candidates.description: Company Description Self-employed business owners in Ibadan offer flexible, customer-focused retail services across various product categories. Working directly with an individual entrepreneur provides opportunities to learn all aspects of small business operations, from sales and customer service to inventory handling. The environment is typically fast-paced and hands-on, with a strong emphasis on reliability and trust. Team members are valued for their contribution to daily business performance and customer satisfaction. Role Description The Sales Attendant is a full-time, on-site role based in Ibadan, responsible for supporting daily retail operations and delivering a positive customer experience. In this role, the Sales Attendant welcomes customers, answers product questions, assists with selections, and processes cash or electronic payments accurately. The position includes arranging and replenishing stock, keeping the sales area clean and organized, and monitoring inventory levels. The Sales Attendant also helps record sales, reports issues or customer feedback to the business owner, and follows all shop policies for security, hygiene, and customer service. Qualifications Strong customer service and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and respectfully with a diverse range of customers. Basic numeracy and cash-handling skills, including accurate processing of transactions and use of point-of-sale or mobile payment systems. Organizational and time-management abilities to handle multiple customer requests, restocking tasks, and daily routines efficiently. Reliability and integrity, including punctuality, honesty in handling cash and goods, and adherence to business policies and procedures. Ability to stand for extended periods, lift and move stock as needed, and maintain a tidy and safe sales environment. Previous experience in retail, sales, or customer-facing roles is an advantage but not strictly required. Basic literacy in English; familiarity with local languages in Ibadan is a plus.
